summaryEn: Teaches you to ask the way politely and understand the directions you are given.
Teaches you to say which transport you take and ask where the stop is.
Teaches you to buy a ticket at the counter, ask about return fares and find the platform.
Teaches you to understand a delay, ask how long it will take and talk about waiting.
Teaches you to give the driver the address, ask how long it takes and talk while paying.
Teaches you to ask whether a place is far and to describe where it is.
Teaches you to ask what there is to see in a town and to make suggestions.
Teaches you to say that you are lost and to follow detailed directions.
Teaches you to talk about cycling, hire a bike and understand warnings.
Teaches you to ask about departure times, platforms and connections at an information desk.
Teaches you to show someone round your home: how many rooms it has and what it is like.
Teaches you the rooms of a home and the article that goes with each one.
Teaches you to say where things are and to tell the position verbs apart.
Teaches you to meet new neighbours and to knock on the door.
Teaches you to understand house rules and to say what is not allowed.
Teaches you to talk about rent and service charges, and shows the warm and cold rent.
Teaches you to talk about housework and puts separable verbs to work on it.
Teaches you to ask for help and to talk about moving day.
Teaches you to describe what is on the balcony and in the garden.
Teaches you to report something broken at home and to ask for it to be repaired.
Teaches you to say what you do in your free time and what you enjoy.
Teaches you to say what you can and cannot do and to ask the other person.
Teaches you to say whether you do sport and how often.
Teaches you to say what music you listen to and which you prefer.
Teaches you to invite someone to the cinema, accept an invitation and agree a time.
Teaches you to describe the weather and to start small talk with it.
Teaches you to describe what there is in a park and to make plans together.
Teaches you to ask the entrance fee, find the changing rooms and say what you can do.
Teaches you to say what you watch, ask about the channel and give the time of a programme.
Teaches you to turn down an invitation without offending and to suggest another day.
Teaches you to name parts of the body and that each one has to be learnt with its article.
Teaches you two ways to say what hurts and to say how long it has been going on.
Teaches you to make an appointment on the phone and that day and time take different prepositions.
Teaches you to express obligation and why the main verb goes to the end of the sentence.
Teaches you to buy medicine at the pharmacy and to understand the polite imperative.
Teaches you to call in sick and which verb to use when you are ill.
Teaches you the informal imperative you use when giving a friend advice.
Teaches you to call for help in an emergency and to give the essential facts on the phone.
Teaches you to state health rules that apply to everyone, using the subject 'man'.
Teaches you to describe toothache and to understand the dentist's short instructions.
Teaches you to introduce yourself on the phone and to ask for someone.
Teaches you to write a short message and to close it properly.
Teaches you to make an appointment, propose a date and postpone it.
Teaches you to invite someone and to say what to bring.
Teaches you to say what you did in the past and shows how the sentence splits in two.
Teaches you that verbs of movement take a different auxiliary in the past.
Teaches you to describe yesterday from start to finish, using both auxiliaries together.
Teaches you to describe your weekend and to say how it went.
Teaches you to name the seasons and to give a date.
Teaches you to say what you have learnt and what comes next.
